description: Quarter-over-quarter 13F position changes for an institutional manager. Parses a fund's 13F-HR information tables and diffs the latest quarter against the prior one: new positions, exits, increases, decreases (with share deltas), and the change in top-10 concentration. CIKs may be zero-padded or not. [HTTP: GET /v1/edgar/13f/:cik/diff · price $0.05 via x402 · docs https://x402-factory.com/docs/gov.edgar-13f-diff]

quarter.description: Defaults to the latest filed quarter
